description: A flat, elastic plain that seems to be made of a jelly-like material. Countless objects are stuck in a loop of endless jumping here. Willy warns: 'Expect the unexpectable to stay grounded!'

stone_wall.description: Warped cliffs made of squishy clay.

jelly.description: 🍮 A wiggly purple jelly trampoline. Walking on it launches you into the air!

exit_north.description: The rift swirling back to the Bridge of Blah.

exit_south.description: A pathway heading south to a dark structure labeled 'Scream Collector'.

gorilla_nest.description: A nest made of giant banana peels and fuzzy fibers. A sign says: 'Gorilla Expectation Spot'.

item.onCollect: You search the nest and find a thick, magical Gorilla Hair! It hums with strong gravity expectative powers.

npc_jumping_friends.description: A friendly Spring and Fidget Spinner are sitting on a binder clip, bouncing slightly.

dialogue.text: "Oh, travelers!" squeaks the Spring. "Welcome to the Land of Endless Jumping! If you don't watch out, you'll jump 50 meters high!"
The Fidget Spinner spins: "Your jumping is fueled by expectation. If you want to stay grounded, you must expect the unexpectable! Like giant gorillas, or fish-eating trees!"
"Whatever you do, don't go to Creativity," warns the Binder Clip. "It's not creative there in spite of the name!"
